name: Purísima (Colombia)
description: White field with two thin triangles of blue and green from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Purísima, a municipality in the department of Córdoba, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: thin triangle from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly
